sections.description: Mimam's Var - WP is a modular design-system operating layer inside WordPress. Centralize your CSS variables, manage theme scales, configure fluid scales, build layout utility structures, and sync seamlessly with Figma.
sections.changelog:
v1.3.238 - Dev

  • Recovery controls now match MV. Backup switches use the shared track and knob proportions without WordPress checkbox glyphs, and passphrase visibility is an inset Phosphor eye action.
  • Restore source has one clear trigger. Only Change opens the package menu; the package card and Ready state remain informational.
  • Live jobs keep their place. Expanded Activity rows remain open through polling while progress and status continue to refresh.
  • Activity is calmer and type is consistent. Package hover actions are cleaner, Recovery text matches surrounding Studios, and completed progress bars, statuses, and task steps no longer shout.

v1.3.237 - Dev

  • Recovery now matches the approved refined Studio. Backup uses the payload-first hierarchy, Restore has the grouped source picker and quieter report, Tools includes compact activity, and the whole panel uses MV's deeper dark palette.
  • History display is configurable without deleting anything. Recent packages and Recent jobs independently support 3, 5, or 10 rows, default to five, and remain separate from schedule retention.
  • Backup labels and options are real. Package labels reach the real backup job, while encryption and server-dump choices save before the backup begins.
  • One side-panel width. Recovery, Variables, Settings, and sidecars now consume the shared 468px width token with narrow-screen constraints preserved.

v1.3.236 - Dev

  • Recovery now matches the approved refined Studio. Restore starts with a clear source card, progresses through one six-stage guarded ladder, and keeps advanced operations in grouped Tools sections with Emergency recovery collapsed.
  • Recovery and the Studio rail now share state. Opening Recovery from its own trigger activates the rail; rail switching, module disablement, and panel close all clear both sides without overlap or a stalled active item.
  • Latest backup is a real source. The default choice now resolves the newest package for Validate, Preview risk, Dry-run, Prepare, Guarded restore, and Verify. Change package, import/reset, readiness, and verification controls are connected.
  • Version labels are honest. The Recovery footer shows the installed MV release while package compatibility metadata continues using Recovery's internal module version.

v1.3.235 - Dev

  • Recovery's results now render in the mock's shapes. 1.3.234 added the CSS for the mock's package rows, key/value cards and risk dots - but nothing emitted that markup, so the renderers still produced the old RestoreBase HTML. The renderers now produce it.
  • Recent packages is a clean list - name, mono id, age, size, lock - with a Download link, instead of a stack of cards each with a status pill row, a Backup ID field and an Actions accordion.
  • Selected package is a key/value card (Backup ID, Source, Destination, Encryption), and Risk preview is a colour-dotted list driven by the real check levels the server returns.
  • Per-row Preview/Validate/Restore buttons are gone - those are the Restore tab's ladder now. Delete stays on the row.

v1.3.234 - Dev

  • Recovery now uses the mock's literal styles. Earlier passes styled around the mock by eye and drifted: buttons were solid lime instead of accent-tinted outlines, the header was lime uppercase instead of white 13px, SAFE badges were lime instead of the mock's soft green, and tabs were pills instead of 8px. Values are now ported from the mock's own CSS.
  • The restore ladder actually gates. Steps are dim and locked until reachable, only the current step shows its action, and completed steps show a result line - the mock's progressive disclosure, which was missing entirely.
  • Step state comes from real results. It is driven by successful API calls rather than by the click, so a failed action never shows as done, and an encrypted package needing a passphrase does not count as validated.

v1.3.233 - Dev

  • Recovery now follows the mock's flow, not just its tabs. The Restore tab is a 6-step guarded ladder - Validate, Preview risk, Dry-run, Prepare, Guarded restore, Verify - each with a safe/destructive badge and its own action, instead of a 4-step strip with the real steps buried in an Advanced accordion.
  • Safe checks can no longer silently vanish. Selected package and Risk preview were hidden by a persisted localStorage flag from the old 'hide safe checks' toggle. The toggle is gone, the sections are permanent, and the stale flag is cleared on load.
  • Third tab: Tools. Advanced recovery tools, system reports and the typed-confirmation restores live there, so the Backup and Restore tabs stay the mock's flow without losing any feature.
  • Backup tab rebuilt to the mock: create-a-backup section with the encrypt passphrase inline, then Recent packages, Schedule & storage, Recent jobs.
  • Header is Recovery Studio with the Backup/Restore/Migrate subtitle; live status moved to the footer state label, as in the mock.

v1.3.232 - Dev

  • Recovery panel actually redesigned. 1.3.231 only resized the old RestoreBase panel; the interior is now the approved design - a Backup / Restore-Migrate tabbed panel with MV-style cards and segmented pills, header renamed to Recovery with the rewind icon.
  • Geometry follows the Variable module - 410px wide, docking right/left or floating according to your panel mode, instead of a hardcoded 468px box pinned top-right.
  • The package section stacks instead of hanging off the side of the panel.
  • Recovery's stylesheet no longer fights itself - stacked !important layers were re-declaring the panel geometry and overriding each other by source order.

v1.3.231 - Dev

  • One motion system across every module. Panels now open and close on the same timing and easing (160ms in, 120ms out, 110ms swap) instead of each surface animating differently. Only transform and opacity are animated, so motion never triggers layout.
  • Switching tools no longer jumps. Panels stay mounted, so switching used to slide one panel out while the next slid in - two shells travelling at once. Switching now holds both in place and cross-fades.
  • The rail shows the switch. The active chip slides between icons rather than the colour simply jumping to a different button. Position is measured from the live button, so the rail's dividers do not throw it off.
  • Recovery matches MV. The panel is now the Settings footprint (468px wide, floating) instead of a 370px full-height drawer, and uses the shared motion. Its icon is now a rewind arrow.
  • Reduced-motion is honoured across panels and the rail.

v1.3.230 - Dev

  • Plugin Studio no longer freezes. It referenced a Content Studio variable that does not exist in its scope, so loading threw a ReferenceError and the list sat on "Loading plugins..." forever.
  • Studio switching no longer dies silently. Clicking a rail or speed-dial tool while its hover tooltip was showing threw "DOMException: insertBefore" - the tooltip was anchored inside a panel being unmounted - which aborted the click before anything opened. The tooltip is now cleared before panels are torn down.
  • Recovery opens from the rail and speed dial, and appears in Settings > Modules so it can be turned off per surface like every other module.
  • Recovery assets no longer serve stale from cache after an MV update: they are versioned by the host plugin version and file mtime, not only the module version.

v1.3.229 - Dev

  • Studio rail lands beside the panel, not inside it. The rail measured the panel while it was still sliding in. getBoundingClientRect() returns the transformed rect, so the panel read as off-screen, the rail's offset clamped to its 8px minimum, and it pinned itself to the right edge - where the panel then finished sliding on top of it. Nothing corrected it afterwards, because a CSS transition fires no style/class mutation and no resize, so neither observer ever ran.
  • The rail now re-measures across the open animation (on transitionend and over the animation window), resolves its position synchronously on mount instead of waiting for a frame, and retries on timers rather than requestAnimationFrame - which never fires while a document is hidden, leaving the rail permanently unpositioned in a backgrounded tab.
  • No redundant re-renders: the rail no longer allocates a new layout object when its position has not actually changed.

v1.3.228 - Dev

  • Recovery is now a Mimam's Var module, not a separate panel. The standalone "RB" admin-bar item is gone when Recovery runs inside MV; Recovery now appears in the Studio rail and speed dial with its own icon, and in Settings > Modules where it can be switched off per surface like every other tool.
  • Rail-aware: the Recovery panel is anchorable by the rail, and the rail opens it through a public event so Recovery keeps owning its own panel markup for now. The rail entry is admin-only, since Recovery has no builder surface.

v1.3.227 - Dev

  • Fixes the critical error in v1.3.226. If the standalone Recovery Studio test harness was still installed, both it and the bundled Recovery module declared the same classes. require_once only de-duplicates by file path, so PHP fatalled with "Cannot redeclare class VE\Modules\Recovery\RecoveryModule" and the site white-screened. MV now skips the bundled module when the harness is already loaded, mirroring the existing Mimam's Bar guard.
  • Please delete the Recovery Studio (Test Harness) plugin. Recovery now ships inside Mimam's Var; the harness is redundant and only the bundled module is maintained.

v1.3.226 - Dev

  • Recovery module: Backup, restore, and site migration now ship inside Mimam's Var as the Recovery module. Create one package that works as both a backup and an import on another site, with guarded restore (validate, preview risk, dry-run, prepare, restore, verify), rollback, and emergency recovery outside wp-admin.
  • Safe by construction: Optional AES-256-GCM package encryption, checksum verification of every package component at import so an incomplete download is caught before a restore rather than during one, resumable chunked download and upload for large packages, and a fast native mysqldump export path that falls back automatically.
  • Studio rail reliability: The rail now keeps looking for its panel instead of resolving position once and giving up (it could stay unpositioned and hidden), and it no longer re-renders on every observer callback when its position has not actually changed.

v1.3.225 - Dev

  • Reliable Studio switching: Variable and other direct Studio panels now switch atomically in single-panel mode, disabled modules clear stale rail state, and the detached rail follows dock, float, and drag positions.
  • Panel-safe tooltips: Compact and rich MV tooltips now measure, flip, and clamp inside their owning Studio or panel while retaining their caret.
  • One shared color picker: Variable, Content Studio Highlight, and Media Studio collection colors now use the same framed picker dimensions and alpha controls.
  • Simpler color channels: HEX remains permanently visible as the value field, while channel tabs are limited to RGB, HSL, and OKLCH.

v1.3.224 - Dev

  • Studio Tool Rail: Added the approved detached, registry-driven rail for direct navigation between Variables, CSS Studio, Media Studio, Content Studio, Plugin Manager, and Settings, with responsive horizontal placement when side space is unavailable.
  • Context And State: Existing panel instances stay mounted while switching; contextual launches keep the rail hidden and restore focus to their originating panel or Bricks element.
  • Guarded Navigation: CSS Studio now confirms before discarding unsaved edits, and compact and rich MV tooltips render placement-aware carets.
  • DRY Runtime: Centralized shared tool metadata, panel composition, lazy mounting, exclusivity, module resolution, CSS preferences, Variable color rows, and Media cleanup with structural regression coverage.

v1.3.223 - Dev

  • One shared color control: Variable creation/editing, Content Studio Highlight, and Media Studio collection colors now use one interaction core with full, compact, and inline presentations.
  • Alpha support: The shared picker adds an alpha slider plus alpha-aware HEX, RGB, HSL, and OKLCH output. Variables retain OKLCH alpha and Media collection accents safely persist eight-digit HEX.
  • Approved visual rhythm: Picker internals now follow the clean Variable control across all consumers, while contextual placement remains surface-owned and Variable name/color rows retain deliberate spacing.

v1.3.222 - Dev

  • Highlight picker repair: Separates the complex color tool from shared dropdown styling, removes its redundant nested frame, and restores a clean MV tool surface.
  • Edge-safe color marker: Clamps the saturation/value marker inside the map so its full ring remains visible at every edge.
  • Color-tool polish: Normalizes map, field, format-tab, spacing, and typography treatment while preserving HEX, RGB, HSL, and OKLCH behavior.

v1.3.221 - Dev

  • Dropdown clipping fix: Shared selects now measure their rendered portal, choose the safer direction, constrain themselves to available viewport space, and scroll internally when needed.
  • Reference-complete menus: Shared selects now use muted group labels, compact lighter rows, restrained MV active states, semantic shortcut icons, and keyboard focus that begins on the current value.
  • Behavior preserved: Existing select data, keyboard controls, outside-click dismissal, taxonomy portals, and fixed Media Studio context-menu coordinates remain intact.

v1.3.220 - Dev

  • Content Studio Enter fix: Native Enter splits now clear MV's temporary selected-block marker before the browser creates the next block, so the new paragraph alone receives the quiet selected state while Shift+Enter remains a line break.
  • Shared dropdown language: MV-owned custom selects, context menus, autocomplete lists, editor popovers, and Mimam's Bar's mode menu now use the approved grouped dark treatment without changing their data or keyboard behavior.
  • Studio backdrop: Content Studio and other wide studios now blur the underlying WordPress or Builder surface and can be dismissed from the backdrop.

v1.3.219 - Dev

  • Content Studio visual refinement: Refines keyword pills, restores list markers and selected-list indentation, fills the remaining writing height, and aligns taxonomy dropdown and menu hover styling to MV.

v1.3.218 - Dev

  • Content Studio editor reliability: Commits focus keywords as pills, removes all glow, matches toolbar heights, removes the writing frame, repairs live Add Block insertion, and adds safe top-level Structure drag ordering.

v1.3.217 - Dev

  • Content Studio block interactions: Adds flat grouped controls, a full writing frame, Structure-to-editor focus, canvas block-type tags, an MV format menu, full highlight color picking, multi-type block insertion, and corrected taxonomy menu dismissal.

v1.3.216 - Dev

  • Content Studio publishing details: Adds the editor context bar and functional Author & Taxonomy controls, balances both side rails, groups B/I/U, flattens the inner alignment controls, and removes selected-control glow.

v1.3.215 - Dev

  • Content Studio layout correction: Moves title and excerpt into Publish, begins writing below the toolbar, aligns surfaces and compact actions to MV, and returns Google/Facebook/X previews beneath SEO guidance and fields.

v1.3.214 - Dev

  • Content Studio mock completion: Corrects the full-width title/excerpt block and neutral editor colors, standardizes rail actions to MV controls, places Google and Facebook/X previews first in SEO, and makes Structure collapse, search, and Add paragraph functional.

v1.3.213 - Dev

  • Content Studio visual alignment: Adopts MV's shared neutral surfaces, typography, control sizing, radii, and accent treatment, and restores live red/green SEO recommendation groups that respond as post content and metadata improve.

v1.3.212 - Dev

  • Content Studio mock parity: Rebuilds the live editor against Claude's approved combined prototype. Editing now occupies the full studio with a compact header, semantic outline, single-line writing toolbar, contextual Publish/SEO/Block cards, internal device preview, Focus mode, persistent editing after save, and real save-state feedback.

v1.3.211 - Dev

  • Import icon correction: Restores the framed file tile in the Settings import drop target and explicitly centers its glyph in every import state.

v1.3.210 - Dev

  • Import icon: Removes the redundant framed icon tile and uses a small unboxed file glyph beside the package text.

v1.3.209 - Dev

  • Import correction: Restores the compact horizontal drop target, forces it to span the full Settings content width, and retains the separate mode caption without the narrow centered box introduced in v1.3.208.

v1.3.208 - Dev

  • Import layout: Reflows the transfer mode switch, explanatory copy, and file drop target vertically so each remains clear at the restored Settings width. The drop target is centered and no longer squeezes its icon, text, and file action into one row.

v1.3.207 - Dev

  • Module surfaces: Fixes module reactivation in Admin and Builder by making the per-surface map authoritative and refreshing both runtimes immediately.
  • Settings transfer: Export names and metadata now identify the source site and time. Import adds branded drag/drop states, automatic inspection, MV/Bricks-separated preview, and reveals group selection after preview.
  • Content Studio: Implements the approved outline, writing canvas, Publish/SEO/Block rail, Focus mode, and preserves the existing post, SEO, media, custom-field, Bricks, and WordPress integrations.

v1.3.206 - Dev

  • Settings consistency: WordPress Admin now displays the saved Mimam's Bar shortcut without requiring the Bar runtime, Settings restores the last section used in the current session, and Builder placement segment labels are centered.
  • Content Studio direction: Adds the adjusted editor mock for review, preserving the outline, writing canvas, and contextual rail while keeping controls within Content Studio's ownership.

v1.3.205 - Dev

  • Settings size: Restores the Settings panel to its original 468px width while preserving the approved contextual layout, MV/Bricks transfer workflow, and all v1.3.204 behavior. Internal label/control tracks remain contained at the restored width.

v1.3.204 - Dev

  • Mimam's Bar: Keeps the Everything indicator current, limits Admin to Everything, moves selection status below the command area, and lets a selected Ctrl+K shortcut take priority over Bricks and other command palettes.
  • Settings: Reorganizes Mimam's Bar preferences into clearer contextual sections with related Builder panel controls and a copyable footer version.
  • Settings Transfer: Adds selective Mimam's Var and Bricks export/import in Admin and Builder, with secret exclusion, schema validation, replacement preview, reviewed-payload fingerprinting, and confirmation before import.

v1.3.203 - Dev

  • Everything mode: Press 0 to search grouped Bar commands, current-page elements, and Add Element results.
  • Per-surface startup: Admin and Builder now have separate default modes and remember-last-mode toggles.
  • Master shortcut: Fresh preferences default to Ctrl+K while saved shortcut choices remain unchanged.
  • Structure spacing: Removed the duplicated Bricks toolbar margin only in Advanced Themer's shortcut-sidebar grid.

v1.3.202 - Dev

  • Reliable wrapping: Strengthened the result title and metadata selectors so older important nowrap rules cannot win the cascade.

v1.3.201 - Dev

  • Wrapped results: Long Add/Search rows wrap inside the command sheet with horizontal overflow disabled.
  • Add progress: Emmet insertion shows the current semantic element, a progress bar, and current/total while Insert is disabled.
  • Mode memory and errors: The Bar restores its last mode, and error messages use a padded branded status treatment.
  • One-line inspector: Run MimamsBarInspectWhitespace() in Console, then click the white area once to report its element and stylesheet rules.

v1.3.200 - Dev

  • Grouped Emmet: The plus operator now creates sibling branch groups, depth is limited per branch instead of across the whole expression, and the reported ten-element expression is accepted.
  • Correct semantic tags: Mapped elements use Bricks' documented tag control and retain semantic labels, so ul, li, article, headings, and inline tags no longer remain default div Blocks.
  • Whitespace diagnostic: Added a click-to-inspect console helper that reports the responsible element and matched stylesheet rules.

v1.3.199 - Dev

  • Dropdown clipping: The open mode menu now overrides the approved mock's later important overflow rule, so all three options remain visible.
  • Semantic Emmet: Safe Add maps ul, ol, li, semantic layout tags, headings, and common text tags to supported Bricks elements while applying the intended HTML tag setting through the adapter.

v1.3.198 - Dev

  • Mimam's Bar dropdown: The mode menu now escapes command-sheet clipping while open, so Direct, Search page, and Add element remain fully visible; normal clipping returns when the menu closes.
  • Automatic rollback history: Release Manager now loads selected-channel history when Settings opens and refreshes after a channel change, without requiring a manual Check update click.

v1.3.197 - Dev

  • Mimam's Bar polish: Inline chip editing no longer shows the extra focus box; chip remove actions now use the Media Studio-style red hover badge; Direct mode can be entered with 1 even when no element is selected and shows a select-first message only when applying non-bulk commands; outside clicks in the top builder document close the bar; suggestions and the Tab/Enter tip keep the command-sheet padding; selected-element classes and attributes are prioritized before generic suggestions.
  • Settings and rollback: Settings footer now shows the installed plugin version, and Release Manager shows only four rollback rows.

v1.3.196 - Dev

  • Mimam's Bar inline editing + polish: Clicking a chip now edits it IN PLACE — class chips rename, attribute chips edit their value, the CSS ID edits inline (Enter applies, Esc cancels) instead of loading a command into the field. Chip remove × now appears only on hover (like Media Studio). Removed the redundant top-right × (the footer Close remains). Made ID/class/attribute chips evenly sized. Nudged the centered bar up slightly so it sits in the visual middle.

v1.3.195 - Dev

  • Mimam's Bar fixes: The bar now opens vertically centered on the page (was anchored too high); removed the empty second divider line under the command row in Direct mode; and existing class chips now have a × to remove them (previously only newly added attributes could be removed). Inline chip editing (edit a value in place instead of loading it into the field) is the next piece.

v1.3.194 - Dev

  • Mimam's Bar → Variant A (compact command sheet): Rebuilt to match the approved Variant A mock: the three mode chips are now a single mode dropdown (Direct/Search page/Add element behind one pill), and in Direct mode the element's ID/classes/attributes render as chips inline in the command row (compact sheet) with the input as the trailing add field. Search/Add modes show the query then their result list. All existing behavior preserved (parser, token highlighting, autosuggest, bulk, mode keys 1/2/3).

v1.3.193 - Dev

  • Mimam's Bar Icons (Phosphor): The command palette now has icons — Phosphor duotone icons on the mode chips (Direct/Search page/Add element) and on every Search/Add result row (image, button, heading, container, text, list). Packages the icon + per-result-metadata work with the product-standard icon set instead of placeholder glyphs/SVGs.

v1.3.192 - Dev

  • Mimam's Bar Pixel-Match: Forced the bar's styling to match the approved command-palette mock exactly — flat #1c1c1c panel (dropped the old gradient), minimal header (no title bar, just the close ×), a borderless inline command input, exact mode-chip pills, clean result rows and empty states, and the exact footer/button styling. This overrides the older theme that was fighting the design.

v1.3.191 - Dev

  • Mimam's Bar Redesign Polish: Made the bar actually match the agreed command-palette design — removed the old Examples block and the boxed "Attributes / Show" chrome, rendered the element's ID, classes, and attributes as editable chips in Direct mode (identity now renders too), and hid the attributes panel in Search page / Add element modes so each mode shows only its own results.

v1.3.190 - Dev

  • Mimam's Bar Redesign (command-palette): Rebuilt the bar layout into a structured command palette — command input on top, visible mode chips (Direct · 1, Search page · 2, Add element · 3) as the switcher, a grouped results area, and a keyboard-hint footer. Modes are now discoverable at a glance and switch by click or 1/2/3. All existing behavior (parser, token highlighting, attribute autosuggest, bulk, toasts, element search/add) is preserved. Also fixed a theme rule that was making the command field opaque and hiding the token color-coding.

v1.3.189 - Dev

  • Command Field Alignment Fix: Fixed the Mimam's Bar command field rendering as an over-tall box with a top-aligned caret in Firefox; the input and its highlight overlay now center on a shared baseline.

v1.3.188 - Dev

  • Mimam's Bar Restyle: The command field is redesigned into a code-style monospace input with live token syntax-highlighting — #id, .class, attr="value", operators, and keywords are color-coded inline as you type, in the spirit of the AT/Bricksforge attribute bar. All existing features (parser, attribute autosuggest, modes, bulk commands, toasts) are unchanged — this is presentation only.

v1.3.187 - Dev

  • Tooltip Caret Fix: Restored the caret on the global tooltip (it was hidden behind the bubble after the v1.3.186 refactor). Carets now render correctly for all placements.

v1.3.186 - Dev

  • Global Tooltip Pattern: Added a reusable branded tooltip (data-ve-tip) with a caret and top/right/left/bottom placement, and made it the standard across MV. The Settings icon rail now uses it directly.

v1.3.185 - Dev

  • Mimam's Bar Attribute Autosuggest: Typing an attribute name in Mimam's Bar now suggests common data-* / ARIA / HTML attributes (and the selected element's existing attributes), inserting name="" with the caret between the quotes so you can type the value immediately. Works for single and bulk (target => …) commands.
  • Settings Tooltip Fix: Removed the duplicate native tooltip on the Settings icon rail so only the branded hover label shows.

v1.3.184 - Dev

  • Settings Icon Rail: The Settings navigation is now an icon-only rail; hovering an icon reveals its label in a panel-contained tooltip with a caret pointing back at the icon.
  • Viewport Inputs: Min/Max viewport controls now show the Min/Max label and the px unit inside each input box for a cleaner, self-contained field.

v1.3.183 - Dev

  • Quick Import / Third-Party Editor Fix: Stopped MV's globally loaded CodeMirror stylesheet from bleeding a white background into other plugins' code editors (e.g. Code2Bricks Quick Import). MV now neutralizes the shared editor defaults so foreign editors keep their own dark theme, while MV's own editors stay dark.
  • Settings Redesign: Replaced the Settings tab row with a left icon-rail navigation (General, Updates & License, Mimam's Bar, CSS Studio, Modules, Media Studio), so every section is reachable and the panel scales cleanly.
  • Viewport Range Polish: Tidied the viewport range card alignment with left-aligned Min/Max labels and inputs.

v1.3.182 - Dev

  • Settings Tabs Reachable: The Settings tab row now wraps to multiple rows so all six tabs (including Modules and Media Studio) stay reachable in the narrow panel instead of being clipped off the right edge.
  • Viewport Range Restyle: Rebuilt the General Settings viewport range as a lighter grouped card with the Min/Max fields using MV's dark input styling and no native number spinners, fixing the white input boxes.

v1.3.181 - Dev

  • Bricks Editor Safety Fix: Widened the Bricks/CodeMirror dark-editor safety rule to cover any code editor inside the Bricks builder (including third-party dialogs such as Code2Bricks Quick Import), not just Bricks' own Custom CSS/Advanced CSS panels.
  • Viewport Inputs Fix: General Settings Min/Max viewport number fields now use MV's dark input styling instead of falling back to native white browser styling.
  • Settings Reorganization: Split the Settings tabs from 4 to 6: General, Updates & License, Mimam's Bar, CSS Studio, Modules, and a new Media Studio tab. Update feed/channel/license/Release Manager moved out of General into their own tab, and Media Studio's runtime/folder-migration tools moved out of Modules into their own tab.

v1.3.180 - Dev

  • Release Manager Layout: Release rows now give title/meta and Download ZIP/Rollback actions their own full-width rows, with quieter status pills that read as labels instead of buttons.
  • Viewport Settings: General Settings viewport Min/Max controls now appear as one related viewport range block.
  • Bricks Editor Safety: Scoped MV Studio input styling back to MV-owned surfaces so Bricks Custom CSS and Advanced CSS editors keep their dark editor backgrounds.
  • Mimam's Bar Settings: Auto-close preference now persists after refresh and before the Bar runtime is mounted.

v1.3.179 - Dev

  • Release Manager Polish: Fixed the empty Release Manager state so it no longer renders a stray numeric zero before release history is loaded.
  • Clearer Package Action: Renamed Package links to Download ZIP and softened release status pills so Installed/Rollback states read as labels, not primary actions.
  • Admin Settings Styling: Restored MV dark input styling for admin-side Settings fields such as License key and update feed fields.

v1.3.178 - Dev

  • Visible Release Manager: Settings now shows the selected-channel Release Manager even before a check has loaded release history.
  • Guarded Rollback: Older selected-channel packages can now be installed from Release Manager after an MV confirmation step. WordPress receives the selected package transient so rollback uses the normal plugin upgrader path and restores activation afterward.
  • Channel Safety: Rollback and update actions remain scoped to the selected channel. Stable and Beta manifests are untouched.

v1.3.177 - Dev

  • Update Feed Hardening: Adds a raw GitHub fallback when the selected channel manifest is blocked through the GitHub API and replaces raw WordPress HTTP errors with a branded, actionable MV message.
  • Release Manager Foundation: Settings can now read channel release history and show package options. Latest updates can install from the selected channel; rollback packages are visible but one-click rollback remains paused until overwrite recovery is hardened.
  • Channel Safety: Development updates remain scoped to the Dev manifest only. Stable and Beta manifests are untouched.

v1.3.176 - Dev

  • Transient Caching for Collections: Implemented ve_media_collections_list Transient caching inside MediaCollectionManager to eliminate N+1 term database queries, significantly optimizing REST API performance. Hooked WordPress taxonomy actions to invalidate cache dynamically.
  • SVG Intrinsic Sizing Fallback: Added min-width/height fallbacks to prevent raw SVG files lacking viewBox or dimensions from collapsing inside masonry cards.

v1.3.175 - Dev

  • SVG Previews Fix: Forces SVG assets to load the original attachment source URL instead of generated thumbnail sizes, bypassing blank placeholder stripes.

v1.3.170-174 - Dev

  • Content Studio Expansion: Added a split-pane content and SEO editor, live readability/headings checklists, SERP previews, and inline dialogs.
  • Bricks Builder Double-Click Picker: Media items now support double-click insertion within Bricks, with click-detail intervals guarding event reliability.
  • CodeMirror Isolation: Scoped editor autocomplete hints strictly to the CSS Studio container to prevent autocomplete conflict/breakage in other code tools.
